verse.text: In the same way, encourage the young men to live wisely. And you yourself must be an example to them by doing good works of every kind. Let everything you do reflect the integrity and seriousness of your teaching.

reflection: Our kids and the guys around us aren't just listening to what we say - they're watching how we actually live. Paul's charge to Titus is simple but weighty: don't just talk about wisdom and integrity, be the example. So today, pick one small thing - your words at dinner, how you handle a mistake, how you treat your wife when you're tired - and let that be a place where your actions preach louder than any lecture ever could.
